layout.arrangement: Title band across the top-left/center inside a blue-outlined box; yellow slide-number badge at the top-right. Below the title, the slide is split into a large left panel and a narrower right column. The left panel contains two side-by-side labeled example columns: Positive Class on the left with +1 labels, Negative Class on the right with 0 labels. The right column contains three stacked panels: Activation Function at the top, Training in the middle, and Evaluation at the bottom.

layout.hierarchy: The title and section headers are the strongest text elements. Color-coded headers dominate: red for Positive Class/Training/Evaluation, green for Negative Class, blue for Activation Function. The airplane sketches and flowcharts occupy the most visual area, while small labels and captions are subordinate.

visual_elements.description: Title container: white-filled rectangle with a blue border. Text reads “Training Samples with Labels [0,1] (Two Classes)”; the bracketed range is red, the remaining title text is dark blue.

Left example panel: red-outlined container split into two class subpanels. Left subpanel headed “Positive Class” and ““Shoot the Enemy”” contains five simple black-outline airplane sketches stacked vertically; a narrow label strip to their right shows +1 five times. Right subpanel headed “Negative Class” and ““Safe”” contains five simple black-outline airplane sketches stacked vertically; a narrow label strip to their right shows 0 five times. The word “Label” appears above each label strip.

Small sigmoid plot inside the Activation Function panel: Cartesian axes with a purple/magenta sigmoid curve rising from lower-left to upper-right. The vertical axis appears marked 0 at the bottom and 1 at the top; the horizontal axis is unlabeled. The curve midpoint corresponds to the stated threshold at 0.5.

Training flow, left-to-right: “Input Sample” capsule → arrow → “Model” box containing a small sigmoid curve, with caption below “(Any value) → (-1, +1)” → arrow → “Predicted Class” node labeled above a small sigmoid curve → arrow → red oval labeled “LOSS” → arrow → “Label of Input Sample” capsule with “(+1, 0)” underneath.

Evaluation flow, left-to-right: “Test Sample” capsule → arrow → “Model” box containing a small sigmoid curve, with caption below “(Any value) → (-1, +1)” → arrow → “Predicted Class” node labeled above a small sigmoid curve → arrow → final capsule labeled “(+1, 0)”.
Yellow circular badge with a black numeral “2”, likely a slide number.

imagery: Five simple black line-art airplane sketches in the Positive Class panel, styled as enemy/target aircraft.
Five simple black line-art airplane sketches in the Negative Class panel, styled as safe/civilian aircraft.
Small purple sigmoid-curve icons inside the Model and Predicted Class nodes of the Training and Evaluation flowcharts.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout, similar to Arial/Calibri. The title is bold and large; section headers are bold and color-coded. Body labels are smaller and regular. “LOSS” is white bold all-caps on a red oval. Class names and the threshold use curly quotation marks. The “+1” and “0” labels are bold and color-coded red/green respectively.
animation_state: No mid-build indicators are visible; all text, examples, charts, and flow nodes appear fully revealed.
